doc.description:
Basic rotorcraft FDM for NPS simulator
Minimum complexity hover-dynamics model, the rotorcraft counterpart of fdm_fixedwing_sim. Its only purpose is to allow testing of flight plans, navigation and guidance with a very simple rotorcraft model, without a full physics backend (JSBSim, Gazebo, ...). Not suitable for control loop tuning: the model responds to the stabilization commands (NPS_USE_COMMANDS), not to individual actuators, so it works with any motor layout. AHRS and INS are bypassed with the true state.

define.name: NPS_ROTORCRAFT_SIM_HOVER_THROTTLE
define.description: normalized thrust command that exactly balances gravity (default: GUIDANCE_V_NOMINAL_HOVER_THROTTLE if defined)

define.name: NPS_ROTORCRAFT_SIM_MAX_TILT_RATE
define.description: roll/pitch rate at full stick in rad/s

define.name: NPS_ROTORCRAFT_SIM_MAX_YAW_RATE
define.description: yaw rate at full stick in rad/s

define.name: NPS_ROTORCRAFT_SIM_ATT_TAU
define.description: time constant of the angular rate response in s
